segments.name: Specialty Products and Solutions
segments.description: Manufactures and markets specialty solvents, waxes, lubricating oils and related products sold to domestic and international industrial and consumer-facing customers as raw material components.
segments.evidence: In our Specialty Products and Solutions segment, we manufacture and market a wide variety of solvents, waxes, customized lubricating oils, white oils, petrolatums, gels, esters, and other products.

segments.name: Performance Brands
segments.description: Blends, packages and markets high performance branded products for consumer and industrial buyers under its own brand names.
segments.evidence: In our Performance Brands segment, we blend, package and market high performance products through our Royal Purple, Bel-Ray, and TruFuel brands.

segments.name: Montana/Renewables
segments.description: Operates renewable fuels and specialty asphalt facilities, processing renewable feedstocks and Canadian crude oil into fuels and asphalt for western North American markets.
segments.evidence: Our Montana/Renewables segment is comprised of two facilities — renewable fuels and specialty asphalt.

revenueModel.text: Customers in domestic and international consumer-facing and industrial markets, local fuel and asphalt markets, and renewable offtake counterparties pay the company for specialty products, branded products, fuels and renewable fuels.
revenueModel.evidence: Our specialty products are sold to domestic and international customers who purchase them primarily as raw material components for consumer-facing and industrial products.

changes.text: In 2025 the company divested the Royal Purple Industrial business, which reduced Performance Brands segment sales.
changes.evidence: Performance Brands segment sales decreased primarily due to lower sales volumes as a result of the divestiture of the Royal Purple Industrial business.
